[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/4/46/Tratado_de_Lisboa_13_12_2007_%2804%29.jpg/250px-Tratado_de_Lisboa_13_12_2007_%2804%29.jpg)](/wiki/File:Tratado_de_Lisboa_13_12_2007_(04).jpg)

In 2007, Bulgaria and Romania became EU members. Later that year, Slovenia adopted the euro,[[45]](#cite_note-Europa_History_00-51) followed by Cyprus and Malta in 2008, Slovakia in 2009, Estonia in 2011, Latvia in 2014, Lithuania in 2015, and Croatia in 2023. On 1 December 2009, the [Lisbon Treaty](/wiki/Treaty_of_Lisbon "Treaty of Lisbon") entered into force and reformed many aspects of the EU. In particular, it changed the legal structure of the EU, merging the [EU three pillars](/wiki/Three_pillars_of_the_European_Union "Three pillars of the European Union") system into a single legal entity provisioned with a [legal personality](/wiki/Legal_personality "Legal personality"), created a permanent [president of the European Council](/wiki/President_of_the_European_Council "President of the European Council"), the first of which was [Herman Van Rompuy](/wiki/Herman_Van_Rompuy "Herman Van Rompuy"), and strengthened the position of the [high representative of the union for foreign affairs and security policy](/wiki/High_Representative_of_the_Union_for_Foreign_Affairs_and_Security_Policy "High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy").[[46]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPiris2010448-52)[[47]](#cite_note-53)

List of Jujutsu Kaisen characters :: Tokyo Prefectural Jujutsu High School :: Faculty and staff :: Atsuya Kusakabe :: chunk_0015
:   Voiced by: [Shin-ichiro Miki](/wiki/Shin-ichiro_Miki "Shin-ichiro Miki")[[26]](#cite_note-26) (Japanese); [Kirk Thornton](/wiki/Kirk_Thornton "Kirk Thornton")[[27]](#cite_note-JJK-EnDub-ComingSoon-27) (English)

Atsuya Kusakabe (日下部 篤也, *Kusakabe Atsuya*) is a Grade 1 sorcerer and faculty member at Tokyo Jujutsu High, specializing in swordsmanship despite lacking an innate technique. He mastered the New Shadow Style: Simple Domain (シン陰流・簡易領域, *Shin Kageryū: Kan'i Ryōiki*), an anti-Domain technique that neutralizes sure-hit effects. His sword techniques include Batto Sword Drawing (抜刀, *Battō*) for enhanced speed and Evening Moon Sword Drawing (居合・夕月, *Iai Yūzuki*), which combines Simple Domain with increased Cursed Energy output. Likely serving as mentor to Kasumi Miwa, who shares his skillset, Kusakabe initially distrusts Yuji Itadori after witnessing Sukuna's power in Shibuya but eventually joins the fight against Kenjaku and Sukuna. During the Shinjuku Showdown, his Simple Domain expertise proves effective against Sukuna before severe injuries force his retreat, rescued by Ui Ui and Miguel.

The [modern Olympics](/wiki/Modern_Olympics "Modern Olympics") began in 1896. Since then, summer and winter games have usually celebrated a four-year period known as an Olympiad. From the inaugural Winter Games in 1924 until 1992, winter and summer Games were held in the same year. Since 1994, summer and winter Games have been held in staggered even years. The last Olympic games were held in both Milan and Cortina, the first to ever be hosted by two cities, in February 2026. With 592,800 square kilometres (228,900 sq mi),[[9]](#cite_note-BGNote-9) Madagascar is the world's [46th-largest country](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_area "List of countries and dependencies by area"),[[110]](#cite_note-cia-122) the [second-largest island country](/wiki/List_of_island_countries "List of island countries")[[111]](#cite_note-world-atlas-123) and the [fourth-largest island](/wiki/List_of_islands_by_area "List of islands by area").[[9]](#cite_note-BGNote-9) The country lies mostly between latitudes [12°S](/wiki/12th_parallel_south "12th parallel south") and [26°S](/wiki/26th_parallel_south "26th parallel south") and longitudes [43°E](/wiki/43rd_meridian_east "43rd meridian east") and [51°E](/wiki/51st_meridian_east "51st meridian east").[[112]](#cite_note-georeport-124) Neighboring islands include the [French territory](/wiki/Overseas_France "Overseas France") of [Réunion](/wiki/R%C3%A9union "Réunion") and the country of [Mauritius](/wiki/Mauritius "Mauritius") to the east, as well as the state of [Comoros](/wiki/Comoros "Comoros") and the French territory of [Mayotte](/wiki/Mayotte "Mayotte") to the northwest. The nearest mainland state is [Mozambique](/wiki/Mozambique "Mozambique"), located to the west.

ExxonMobil Chemical is a petrochemical company that was created by merging Exxon's and Mobil's chemical industries in 1999. Its principal products include basic [olefins](/wiki/Olefin "Olefin") and [aromatics](/wiki/Aromatic "Aromatic"), [ethylene glycol](/wiki/Ethylene_glycol "Ethylene glycol"), [polyethylene](/wiki/Polyethylene "Polyethylene"), and [polypropylene](/wiki/Polypropylene "Polypropylene") along with speciality lines such as [elastomers](/wiki/Elastomer "Elastomer"), [plasticizers](/wiki/Plasticizer "Plasticizer"), [solvents](/wiki/Solvent "Solvent"), process fluids, [oxo alcohols](/wiki/Oxo_alcohol "Oxo alcohol") and [adhesive](/wiki/Adhesive "Adhesive") [resins](/wiki/Resin "Resin"). The company also produces synthetic lubricant base stocks as well as lubricant additives, [propylene](/wiki/Propylene "Propylene") packaging films and [catalysts](/wiki/Catalysis "Catalysis"). ExxonMobil is the world's largest producer of butyl rubber.[[45]](#cite_note-46) Infineum, a joint venture with Shell plc, is manufacturing and marketing [crankcase](/wiki/Crankcase "Crankcase") lubricant additives, [fuel additives](/wiki/Fuel_additive "Fuel additive"), and specialty lubricant additives, as well as [automatic transmission fluids](/wiki/Automatic_transmission_fluid "Automatic transmission fluid"), [gear oils](/wiki/Gear_oil "Gear oil"), and industrial oils.[[46]](#cite_note-47)

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/95/Tilsitz_1807.JPG/250px-Tilsitz_1807.JPG)](/wiki/File:Tilsitz_1807.JPG)

*[The Meeting of Napoleon I and Tsar Alexander I at Tilsit](/wiki/The_Meeting_of_Napoleon_I_and_Tsar_Alexander_I_at_Tilsit "The Meeting of Napoleon I and Tsar Alexander I at Tilsit")* by [Adolphe Roehn](/wiki/Adolphe_Roehn "Adolphe Roehn"), 1808

Events were rapidly heading towards the rupture of the Franco-Russian alliance. While Alexander assisted Napoleon in the [War of the Fifth Coalition](/wiki/War_of_the_Fifth_Coalition "War of the Fifth Coalition") in 1809, he declared plainly that he would not allow the [Austrian Empire](/wiki/Austrian_Empire "Austrian Empire") to be crushed out of existence. Napoleon subsequently complained bitterly of the inactivity of the Russian troops during the campaign. The tsar in turn protested against Napoleon's encouragement of the Poles. In the matter of the French alliance he knew himself to be practically isolated in Russia, and he declared that he could not sacrifice the interest of his people and empire to his affection for Napoleon. "I don't want anything for myself", he said to the French ambassador, "therefore the world is not large enough to come to an understanding on the affairs of Poland, if it is a question of its restoration".[[31]](#cite_note-34)[[32]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEZawadzki2009110–124-35)

Alexander complained that the [Treaty of Schönbrunn](/wiki/Treaty_of_Sch%C3%B6nbrunn "Treaty of Schönbrunn"), which added largely to the [Duchy of Warsaw](/wiki/Duchy_of_Warsaw "Duchy of Warsaw"), had "ill requited him for his loyalty", and he was only mollified for the time being by Napoleon's public declaration that he had no intention of restoring Poland, and by a convention, signed on 4 January 1810, but not ratified, abolishing the Polish name and orders of chivalry.[[33]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEPhillips1911558-36

fanoutqa_002176.t: Ovarian cancer :: Epidemiology :: United Kingdom :: chunk_0054
fanoutqa_002176.x:
Ovarian cancer :: Epidemiology :: United Kingdom :: chunk_0054
It is the 5th-most common cancer in UK women (around 7,100 were diagnosed in 2011) and the 5th-most common cause of cancer death in women (around 4,300 died in 2012).[[145]](#cite_note-145)[[32]](#cite_note-DynaMed15-32)[[35]](#cite_note-CRUKRisks-35) The incidence rate over the whole UK population is 21.6 per 100,000.

As of 2014, the UK saw approximately 7,000–7,100 yearly diagnoses with 4,200 deaths.[[29]](#cite_note-Jayson-29)[[35]](#cite_note-CRUKRisks-35) A 2022 article from *The Times* put the estimate at 7,500 new cases yearly in Britain.[[146]](#cite_note-thetimes2022-146) Early symptoms are often mistaken for common conditions such as cystitis or irritable bowel syndrome, and about 40 per cent of UK women wrongly believe that cervical screening detects ovarian cancer, an increase from 30 per cent in 2016.[[146]](#cite_note-thetimes2022-146)

Black women have twice the risk for sex cord-stromal tumors compared to non-Black women.[[33]](#cite_note-Williams12-33) The highest prevalence is in Caucasian and Hispanic women, followed by African-American and Asian women.[[139]](#cite_note-Gaona20-139) The highest mortality from ovarian cancer is in African-American women.[[139]](#cite_note-Gaona20-139) [Ashkenazi Jewish](/wiki/Ashkenazi_Jew "Ashkenazi Jew") women carry mutated *BRCA* alleles five times more often than the rest of the population, giving them a higher risk developing ovarian cancer.[[29]](#cite_note-Jayson-29)
